subjects.description: Is it a study on people?
subjects.title: Subjects

source.description: Does it report its own data, or summarize other studies?
source.title: Source

systematic_methods.description: Does it say how it searched and how it chose studies, or call itself systematic, scoping, umbrella or a meta-analysis?
systematic_methods.title: Systematic Methods

pools.description: Does it pool results into one number?
pools.title: Pools

individual_patients.description: Does it describe one or a few patients individually?
individual_patients.title: Individual Patients

gave_exposure.description: Did the researchers give the exposure, with results comparing the outcome by who got it, how much, or before and after?
gave_exposure.title: Gave Exposure

concurrent_comparison.description: Is there a concurrent comparison group: placebo, none or another dose?
concurrent_comparison.title: Concurrent Comparison

by_chance.description: Was who got what assigned by chance, to individuals or to clusters?
by_chance.title: By Chance

proxy_or_event.description: Does the exposure come only from genetic proxies or an outside event, such as a fortification policy?
proxy_or_event.title: Proxy Or Event

selected_by_outcome.description: Were participants picked because they had the outcome or did not?
selected_by_outcome.title: Selected By Outcome

measured_before.description: Was the exposure measured before the outcome was assessed?
measured_before.title: Measured Before

Effect.description: What happened to the measure as reported, before polarity is applied.
Effect.title: Effect

claim.description: One plain-language sentence stating the finding.
claim.title: Claim

quote.description: The sentence from the abstract that reports this finding, copied exactly: a Results sentence, or a Conclusion sentence only when no Results sentence reports it.
quote.title: Quote

outcome_reported.description: The outcome measure as the abstract names it, including the instrument when the abstract names one, such as 'symptom severity (PHQ-9)' or 'PHQ-9 score'.
outcome_reported.title: Outcome Reported

effect.description: What happened to the measure with the intervention compared with the comparator: increased, decreased, or no_change when the abstract reports no significant difference.

is_primary.description: True if the abstract names this as the study's primary outcome.
is_primary.title: Is Primary

is_subgroup.description: True if the result covers only part of the analyzed sample, split by a characteristic such as sex, age or baseline exposure. A study that enrolled only one group reports that group as its population, not as a subgroup.
is_subgroup.title: Is Subgroup

subgroup.description: For a subgroup result, which part of the sample it covers, as the abstract names it. Null for a result on the whole analyzed sample.
subgroup.title: Subgroup

intervention.description: Agent, dose, duration, route and form, as reported.
intervention.title: Intervention

comparator.description: Placebo, active treatment or usual care, as reported.
comparator.title: Comparator

domain_outcome.description: The entry of the outcome domain this finding is on, or 'outside the domain' when its outcome fits none.
domain_outcome.title: Domain Outcome

baseline_vitamin_d_status.description: Baseline serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D band of this finding's population, cut at 20 ng/mL (50 nmol/L), the deficiency cut-off in the Endocrine Society's 2011 guideline; its 2024 guideline endorses no thresholds, so the cut-off only groups studies. below_20_ng_ml: strictly below 20 ng/mL (50 nmol/L). at_or_above_20_ng_ml: 20 ng/mL (50 nmol/L) or higher; exactly 20 ng/mL (50 nmol/L) is at_or_above_20_ng_ml. A subgroup finding takes its subgroup's band. Assign the band by precedence: (a) if the population was restricted by vitamin D status at eligibility, use that restriction, but only when its whole range is strictly below 20 ng/mL (50 nmol/L) or at or above it, in either unit; a restriction that includes values on both sides, such as ≤20 ng/mL, ≤50 nmol/L, <30 ng/mL or <75 nmol/L, does not settle the band; a restriction that settles it applies to every finding in the study, subgroups included; (b) otherwise, use the baseline mean or median the abstract reports for that population; a mean or median for the whole sample does not carry over to a subgroup; (c) use mixed only when the abstract reports values on both sides of 20 ng/mL with no single summary for that population; (d) otherwise not_reported. Words such as low, deficient or hypovitaminosis D without a number do not settle the band.
baseline_vitamin_d_status.title: Baseline Vitamin D Status

design_answers.description: Every design question, each answered on the abstract's own facts; a question that does not fit the study is answered no.

sample_size.description: Participants enrolled or randomized, not analyzed; null if the abstract does not say.
sample_size.title: Sample Size

review_summary.description: For a review only, systematic, meta-analysis or narrative: one sentence summarizing its conclusion. Null for any other design.
review_summary.title: Review Summary

other_outcomes.description: Outcomes outside the outcome domain that the abstract reports results for, named as the abstract names them. Empty if there are none.
other_outcomes.title: Other Outcomes

findings.description: Every finding the abstract reports, one per outcome, arm or subgroup. Empty for a review.
findings.title: Findings
